purpose: separate common-volatility state transport failure from fine-measurement support drift after the stopped STAR50 V3.2/V3.3/V3.4 scale-score route; this audit cannot rescue or promote that route

layer_A_common_state_transport.universe: all clock-scope rows with finite log_sigma_pre and log_rv480; no quiet/event filter
layer_A_common_state_transport.support_limit: 99th percentile of each 2022-2023 row's leave-one-out 100th-neighbor distance in the same exact group
audit_outputs: state extrapolated fraction by fixed minute bands 31-55,56-80,81-105
marginal historical-envelope exceedance for log_sigma_pre and log_rv480 using groupwise 1%-99% historical bounds

layer_B_measurement_support.universe: all clock-scope rows before requiring fine-feature availability
layer_B_measurement_support.source_semantics: 3s input is a variable-density snapshot observation surface, not trade/orderbook event flow; no interpolation or forward-filled missing endpoints

layer_C_star50_route_support.universe: V3.4-like causal quiet decision rows without reading any future label: minute 31-105, quiet_pre=true, current first_tail=false, no first_tail observed in prior 30 minutes, finite primary_scale_score/log_sigma_pre/log_rv480
layer_C_star50_route_support.state_support_definition: same 2022-2023 exact-clock 100-neighbor support rule as layer A
audit_outputs: route-support extrapolated fraction by year/month/half-session/minute band
measurement metrics split by in-support vs extrapolated state rows

interpretation_rules: If both indices show similar 2024/2025 state-extrapolation increases, describe this as evidence of common state-transport drift, not STAR50-specific precursor failure.
If STAR50 state drift is much larger than CSI1000 under the same clock/state definition, describe it as STAR50-specific state transport mismatch, not a causal mechanism.
If fine measurement availability/gap/age metrics change materially at the same time, report a mixed state-plus-measurement concern; do not adjust the stopped scale score.
If measurement metrics are stable while state support deteriorates, prioritize future protocols that explicitly model state transport rather than treating the issue as a 3s data-quality artifact.
No numerical threshold in this audit can promote a risk gate.
do_not: use any t+ future shock label
evaluate event recall, precision, Clean risk or PnL
retune V3.2/V3.3/V3.4 score, K, matching dimensions or thresholds
reinterpret snapshot row counts as trade intensity
